system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- C01 (Production index) ---
Cirrus Components document production, tranche 3, cover index. 15 documents, Bates CIR-004100 to CIR-004380. Produced subject to confidentiality order.

--- C02 (Invoices) ---
Accounts-receivable invoice batch, Q1. Routine billing to several customers including Meridian. Amounts and dates only.

--- C03 (QA log) ---
Quality log entry, 14 March: 'Batch 7 sensor yield anomaly flagged at incoming test; dispositioned use-as-is, monitor field returns.'

--- C04 (HR) ---
Staff roster and shift schedule for the quarter. Routine.

--- C05 (Internal email) ---
Email from engineering lead to QA manager, 5 April: 'I'm not certain, but the field dropouts we're hearing about might be the Batch 7 units - we should run the tests before we say anything externally.'

--- C06 (Logistics) ---
Shipping manifest: Batch 7 units despatched to Meridian on 22 March, with carrier and tracking references.

--- C07 (Purchasing) ---
Purchasing note, February: 'Resin lot substituted to a lower-cost alternative for Batch 7; vendor certificate of analysis states variance within tolerance.'

--- C08 (Marketing) ---
Product launch marketing deck. Messaging and positioning slides. Routine.

--- C09 (Support tickets) ---
Customer support export: three Meridian units logged with intermittent sensor dropout, tickets opened 2-9 April.

--- C10 (Ops minutes) ---
Operations meeting minutes, 18 March: 'Decision to proceed with Q1 shipments to meet quarter targets; outstanding QA monitor items noted as non-blocking.'

--- C11 (Expenses) ---
Expense reimbursement report for the sales team. Routine.

--- C12 (Facilities) ---
Facilities memo on car-park allocation and building access. Routine.

--- C13 (Supplier CoA) ---
Resin supplier certificate of analysis for the substituted lot: records a measured parameter near the edge of the stated tolerance band.

--- C14 (Customer email) ---
Unrelated routine customer email about a reorder of a different product line.

--- C15 (IT policy) ---
IT acceptable-use policy, standard terms. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
| Document | What it is | Deal-partner note |
|---|---|---|
| **C01 – Production index** | Cover index for Cirrus Components’ third document-production tranche (15 documents; CIR-004100–CIR-004380). | Produced subject to a confidentiality order. |
| **C02 – Invoices** | Q1 accounts-receivable batch, including routine billing to several customers, among them Meridian. | Contains amounts and dates only; no specific issue apparent from the description. |
| **C03 – QA log** | 14 March quality entry on Batch 7’s sensor yield anomaly. | Anomaly was flagged at incoming test, then dispositioned “use-as-is” with field returns to be monitored. |
| **C04 – HR** | Quarterly staff roster and shift schedule. | Routine; no specific issue apparent. |
| **C05 – Internal email** | 5 April email from engineering lead to QA manager about possible field dropouts. | Engineering suspected the issues might involve Batch 7 and called for testing before external statements. This is tentative, not a confirmed finding. |
| **C06 – Logistics** | Shipping manifest for Batch 7 units sent to Meridian on 22 March. | Carrier and tracking references may help establish shipment and delivery timing. |
| **C07 – Purchasing** | February purchasing note on a resin substitution for Batch 7. | Lower-cost alternative was used; vendor CoA reportedly placed the variance within tolerance. Relevant to the QA issue. |
| **C08 – Marketing** | Product-launch messaging and positioning deck. | Routine based on the description; no specific issue apparent. |
| **C09 – Support tickets** | Customer-support export recording three Meridian units with intermittent sensor dropout, tickets opened 2–9 April. | Corroborates reported field issues shortly after shipment; link to Batch 7 is not established in this description. |
| **C10 – Ops minutes** | 18 March operations meeting minutes on Q1 shipments. | Team proceeded to meet quarter targets despite outstanding QA monitor items, which were treated as non-blocking. Relevant to shipment decision-making. |
| **C11 – Expenses** | Sales-team expense reimbursement report. | Routine; no specific issue apparent. |
| **C12 – Facilities** | Memo on car-park allocation and building access. | Routine; no specific issue apparent. |
| **C13 – Supplier CoA** | Certificate of analysis for the substituted resin lot. | A measured parameter was near the tolerance-band edge. Compare with C07’s characterization and investigate whether it relates to the Batch 7 anomaly. |
| **C14 – Customer email** | Routine reorder email for a different product line. | Unrelated to the apparent Batch 7 / Meridian issue. |
| **C15 – IT policy** | Standard acceptable-use policy. | Routine; no specific issue apparent. |
